description:
Lists of names according to different households. 
(1) Netanʾel and his sons Yeshuʿa and Saʿadya; the latter's sons Netanʾel and Shemuʾel and Saʿadya and Yiftaḥ; and his son Nadiv; the latter's sons Netanʾel ha-Rofeʾ and his son Elʿazar and his two sons Netanʾel and Yeshuʿa and Elʿazar and Nadiv. 

(2) The household of the scribe (bayt al-Sofer), yisraʾelim: Shabbetay and his son Elʿazar [... ha-Sofer] ha-Mahir; his son Yehuda; Yosef and his son Elʿazar ha-ḥazzan; his sons Yehuda and Shemarya and Yeshuʿa and his brother Peraḥya(?) ha-Ḥazzan; his son Shemarya; his son Yoʾel ha-Sofer ha-Mahir; his son Shela and his two sons Yoʾel and Elʿazar; his son Peraḥya ha-Baḥur ha-Talmid who died young.

(3) Moshe and his son Avraham; Yosef and Shela and his sons Netanʾel and Elʿazar and Yeshuʿa ha-ʿOse(?); his two sons Shemuʾel and Elʿazar. 

(4) The household of the captive (bayt al-Shavuy): Concluding with Reʾuven and Elʿazar and his son [...] and his son Netanʾel Zaqen ha-ʿEda. 

(5) The household of al-Damiri (bayt al-Damīrī): Moshe and his son Elʿazar and his son Shelomo. . . ; Yiṣḥaq and his son Nissim; Avraham and his son Ṭoviyya.
description_he: רשימות שמות לפי משקי בית שונים: משק בית הסופר, משק בית השבוי, משק בית אל-דמירי.
